content: More advanced configurations can be developed by composing multiple configurations files and overrides. Figure FIGREF29 shows a config file that overrides a default config, defining an experiment that uses BERT as the sentence encoder. This config includes an example of a task-specific configuration, which can be overridden in another config file or via a command line override.
